title.narrative: Support in updating Tajikistan’s Nationally Determined Contribution under the framework of the Paris Agreement on Climate Change (NDC 3.0)

description.narrative: The overall project objective is to support the Government of Tajikistan in conducting a stocktaking and update of its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), thereby fulfilling the country’s obligations under the Paris Agreement within the current cycle of revising national climate targets and commitments (NDC 3.0)The overall project objective is to support the Government of Tajikistan in conducting a stocktaking and update of its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), thereby fulfilling the country’s obligations under the Paris Agreement within the current cycle of revising national climate targets and commitments (NDC 3.0)
